      "observations": [
        "The IDL removes nsIMsgWindow.domWindow/rootDocShell and nsIMsgCompose.domWindow. UI setup now changes the actual window.browsingContext.docShell allowAuth/useErrorPages state directly. Compose retains its private m_window and closes it only when present; absence is allowed for silent forwarding/replies.",
        "Prompt paths use nsIWindowMediator.GetMostRecentWindow(nullptr) and nsIPromptService instead of deriving a prompt from a message-window root docshell. This includes folder confirmations, IMAP login/rename/delete, MDN and filter errors. MessageSend instead falls back to the most recent msgcompose window. These are distinct filters, not proof of exact originating-window ownership.",
        "Local ConfirmFolderDeletion still requires aMsgWindow, aFolder and aResult; CopyFolderLocal only calls it when msgWindow is present. The old xpcshell move-back-to-root prompt-failure scenario is deleted. Removing rootDocShell does not mean every background operation must prompt.",
        "GetTopmostMsgWindow loses all matching logic, sets the output to null and returns NS_ERROR_FAILURE. The accepted shutdown caller still ignores that result, passes the null topMsgWindow to progress, and separately requires a most recent DOM window. No runtime shutdown outcome is established.",
        "GetLoadGroup now sets its output null and returns NS_ERROR_NULL_POINTER. IMAP NewChannel removes docshell notification callbacks while retaining SetLoadInfo, attachment disposition, mock-channel association and an explicit NS_OK reset. No protocol or authentication behavior is proved by this source removal.",
        "The owned nsMsgWindow class retains GetMessageWindowDocShell/DoContent/CanHandleContent, but its root weak reference has no writer after SetRootDocShell is removed; only the two weak-reference reads and declaration remain. The fixed accepted class and IDL are later minimal shells, a separate phase.",
        "SendMsg moves the progress STATE_START notification into the non-auto-save and mailnews.show_send_progress branches. The accepted counterpart keeps that narrower branch. This changes when the notification is sent; it does not demonstrate that all observers require it.",
        "DeleteTmpAttachments drops the m_window guard while keeping a comment that describes an open-window check. Both owned promise success and failure paths call deletion. The accepted function later removes the stale comment, and its caller separately uses mSendInFlight/window state; those later ownership changes are not credited to this commit.",
        "The certificate-error test registers both dialog callbacks before Send and awaits allSettled without inspecting statuses. Location/problem and certificate exception assertions have nonempty expected-behavior messages. Existing shared certificate-test knowledge already records the settlement limit; the log that dialogs were shown is not a new assertion.",
        "The new removeLoginInfo helper removes a specific constructed login asynchronously, but its JSDoc says it adds logins. The accepted helper keeps that mismatch. This is a local summary/implementation mismatch, not a global comment rule.",
        "First-run tests remove domWindow identity assertions while retaining initialization/session checks; reuse the existing focused first-run lesson. The attachment-reminder test adds timer turns and a nonempty send-button assertion with should; an event turn is not proof of all asynchronous completion.",
        "The debug database destructor removes local-build per-database path diagnostics while keeping the cache-length warning. The filter failure paths now ask ContinueExecutionPrompt without m_msgWindow in the two changed callbacks; other existing macro/caller guards remain. ThrowConfirmationPrompt still discards the Confirm return code and returns NS_OK after service acquisition.",
        "Full primary and own review are now reconciled within the eligible Thunderbird/shared scope. The six actual inline bodies map only to MessageSend.sys.mjs, nsMsgMailSession.cpp and the debug-database diagnostic hunk. None concern the two excluded content-policy paths; raw discussion remains private. The earlier product-exposure correction remains a separate private receipt.",
        "The author chooses the topmost window over null for alert/confirm but explicitly defers broader cleanup. The reviewer confirms the GetTopmostMsgWindow result is always failure and suggests an immediate return; the author leaves that cleanup for later. Exact owned and accepted source retain the failure-only ternary, so no immediate-return adoption is claimed.",
        "The author reports Windows reportError alerts swallowed with a null window and says local warning-path printing caused use-after-free in tests. These are historical explanations, not reproduced platform/crash results. Source removes detailed path printing but retains the cache warning. Reviewer praise and Green Try do not prove broader prompt correctness. Related regressions and the moved obsolete status-feedback attachment remain bounded locators, not this commit’s behavioral proof."
